Vehicle details you enter, mileage, maintenance, fuel and check records, attached photos and receipts, album photos and notes, and app settings. Everything stays on this device. An account is optional.

Your vehicle details and records are not sent to Chageun. If you sign up for a Chageun account (email or Google), only your email and a Firebase user ID are kept by Google Firebase. If you turn on Google Drive backup, the backup file (records, photos and album, with the plate number masked) is saved to a hidden app folder in your own Google Drive; Chageun\'s operator cannot access it, and it uses your Drive storage. Dashboard photos and car cut-outs are processed on the device only. To improve the app, usage events such as “a fuel record was saved” are sent to Google Firebase Analytics without your plate number, record details, questions, email or advertising ID. If the app crashes, the error details and device model are sent to Google Firebase Crashlytics. You can turn both off in Settings › Privacy. To show ads, the Google Mobile Ads SDK contacts Google and may use your device\'s advertising ID, depending on your consent. When you ask an external AI, you see the exact text first and choose the app to share it with. Plate number, owner and location are never included.

The plate number is encrypted with a key kept in the Android Keystore and is shown masked. Location and camera details are removed from photos when they are attached. App data is not included in Android\'s automatic backup or device transfer; it leaves the device only as a ZIP file you export or a Google Drive backup you turn on.

Settings › Data lets you export everything to a ZIP file, send it to another device, restore it, or delete it all, and turn Google Drive backup on or off. Settings › Account lets you delete your account, which removes your email and user ID. Google Drive backups stay in your Drive; delete them in Google Drive › Settings › Manage apps. Uninstalling the app removes the data on this device.

Maintenance intervals are general recommendations, not manufacturer values, unless you changed them. Answers from external AI apps can be wrong. Follow your owner\'s manual and a qualified mechanic for safety decisions.
